rdfs:label: Article
rdfs:comment: An article — a written work, typically published as part of a larger publication.
notes: Subclass of `urn:solid:CreativeWork` (schema:CreativeWork). Use for blog posts, news articles, papers. Pair with `urn:solid:headline`, `urn:solid:articleBody`, `urn:solid:author` for full schema.org-style modelling. Not `as:Article` (https://www.w3.org/ns/activitystreams#Article), the ActivityPub long-form object; use that in AP payloads (or `as:Note` for short posts).

examples.title: A blog post as an Article

history.note: Superclass corrected to CreativeWork; disambiguated from as:Article; example uses author/headline.
